category: 微觀世界 I/Microscopic World I
questionText:
如下圖所示，一片含硝酸鉀的凝膠放在載玻片上，兩端插有碳電極 X 和 Y，並連接到直流電源。在凝膠中央相隔少許的位置，分別滴上一滴硫酸鎳(II)溶液（靠近 Y）和一滴鉻酸鉀溶液（靠近 X），然後接通電源一段時間。其後，以含蔗糖（不含硝酸鉀）的凝膠重複實驗。下列哪項正確描述預期的觀察？
As shown in the diagram below, a piece of gel containing potassium nitrate is placed on a glass slide. Carbon electrodes X and Y are inserted at its two ends and connected to a d.c. power supply. Near the centre of the gel, a little apart, a drop of nickel(II) sulphate solution (nearer Y) and a drop of potassium chromate solution (nearer X) are placed separately, and the power supply is switched on for some time. The experiment is then repeated using a gel containing sucrose instead of potassium nitrate. Which of the following correctly describes the expected observations?

options.A:
綠色斑移向 Y，黃色斑移向 X；改用蔗糖凝膠後，兩斑基本上不移動。
The green patch moves towards Y and the yellow patch moves towards X; with the sucrose gel, both patches remain essentially unmoved.
options.B:
綠色斑移向 X，黃色斑移向 Y；改用蔗糖凝膠後，兩斑基本上不移動。
The green patch moves towards X and the yellow patch moves towards Y; with the sucrose gel, both patches remain essentially unmoved.
options.C:
綠色斑移向 Y，黃色斑移向 X；改用蔗糖凝膠後，兩斑同樣移動。
The green patch moves towards Y and the yellow patch moves towards X; with the sucrose gel, both patches move in the same way.
options.D:
綠色斑移向 X，黃色斑移向 Y；改用蔗糖凝膠後，兩斑同樣移動。
The green patch moves towards X and the yellow patch moves towards Y; with the sucrose gel, both patches move in the same way.

questionText:

options.A:
用漂白水除去衣物上的污漬
Removing stains on clothes with bleach
options.B:
在切開的蘋果上塗丙種維生素，以減慢蘋果變褐
Applying vitamin C on a cut apple to slow down browning
options.C:
服用含氫氧化鎂的胃藥，以舒緩胃酸過多
Taking an antacid containing magnesium hydroxide to relieve excess stomach acid
options.D:
銀器在含硫化氫的空氣中變黑
Silverware turning black in air containing hydrogen sulphide

category: 酸和鹽基/Acids and Bases
questionText:
某固體酸 $\mathrm{H_{n}Z}$ 的相對分子質量為 192.0。把 1.60 g 該酸溶於水，並調校成 $250.0\ \text{cm}^3$ 溶液。完全中和 $25.00\ \text{cm}^3$ 此溶液需要 $20.83\ \text{cm}^3$ $0.120\ \text{M}$ 氫氧化鈉溶液。n 的值是多少？
A solid acid $\mathrm{H_{n}Z}$ has a relative molecular mass of 192.0. 1.60 g of the acid is dissolved in water and made up to $250.0\ \text{cm}^3$ of solution. $20.83\ \text{cm}^3$ of $0.120\ \text{M}$ sodium hydroxide solution is required to completely neutralise $25.00\ \text{cm}^3$ of this solution. What is the value of n?

category: 酸和鹽基/Acids and Bases
questionText:
把 $20.0\ \text{cm}^3$ $0.30\ \text{M}$ 硝酸鋅溶液與 $30.0\ \text{cm}^3$ $0.20\ \text{M}$ 氫氧化鈉溶液混合。假設氫氧化鋅完全不溶於水，且混合後的總體積為 $50.0\ \text{cm}^3$。所得溶液中 $\mathrm{Zn^{2+}(aq)}$ 的濃度是多少？
$20.0\ \text{cm}^3$ of $0.30\ \text{M}$ zinc nitrate solution is mixed with $30.0\ \text{cm}^3$ of $0.20\ \text{M}$ sodium hydroxide solution. Assume that zinc hydroxide is completely insoluble in water and that the total volume after mixing is $50.0\ \text{cm}^3$. What is the concentration of $\mathrm{Zn^{2+}(aq)}$ in the resulting solution?

questionText:
下圖所示的裝置用來裂解柴油。下列哪項有關這實驗的陳述不正確？
The set-up shown below is used to crack diesel. Which of the following statements concerning this experiment is INCORRECT?

options.A:
氧化鋁粒作為催化劑，令裂解可在較低溫度下進行。
The aluminium oxide pellets act as a catalyst so that cracking can occur at a lower temperature.
options.B:
收集到的第一試管氣體應棄掉，因為它主要含有裝置內原有的空氣。

options.C:
收集到的氣體能令酸化高錳酸鉀溶液由紫色變為無色。

options.D:
實驗結束時，應先移走本生燈，然後才把導管移離水中。
At the end of the experiment, the Bunsen burners should be removed before taking the delivery tube out of the water.

questionText:

$\mathrm{2CH_3COCH_3(l) + 8O_2(g) \rightarrow 6CO_2(g) + 6H_2O(l)}$　　$\Delta H = -3\,580\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$

The following enthalpy changes are given:
$\mathrm{2CH_3COCH_3(l) + 8O_2(g) \rightarrow 6CO_2(g) + 6H_2O(l)}$　　$\Delta H = -3\,580\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$

category: 氧化還原反應、化學電池和電解/Redox Reactions, Chemical Cells and Electrolysis
questionText:
下圖所示的電解裝置中，電極 X 是銀，電極 Y 是碳，電解質是硝酸鉀溶液。通電初期，兩電極上的主要反應是什麼？
In the electrolysis set-up shown below, electrode X is silver, electrode Y is carbon and the electrolyte is potassium nitrate solution. What are the main reactions at the two electrodes at the beginning of the electrolysis?

options.A:
X：$\mathrm{4OH^-(aq) \rightarrow O_2(g) + 2H_2O(l) + 4e^-}$；Y：$\mathrm{2H^+(aq) + 2e^- \rightarrow H_2(g)}$
X: $\mathrm{4OH^-(aq) \rightarrow O_2(g) + 2H_2O(l) + 4e^-}$; Y: $\mathrm{2H^+(aq) + 2e^- \rightarrow H_2(g)}$
options.B:
X：$\mathrm{4OH^-(aq) \rightarrow O_2(g) + 2H_2O(l) + 4e^-}$；Y：$\mathrm{Ag^+(aq) + e^- \rightarrow Ag(s)}$
X: $\mathrm{4OH^-(aq) \rightarrow O_2(g) + 2H_2O(l) + 4e^-}$; Y: $\mathrm{Ag^+(aq) + e^- \rightarrow Ag(s)}$
options.C:
X：$\mathrm{Ag(s) \rightarrow Ag^+(aq) + e^-}$；Y：$\mathrm{K^+(aq) + e^- \rightarrow K(s)}$
X: $\mathrm{Ag(s) \rightarrow Ag^+(aq) + e^-}$; Y: $\mathrm{K^+(aq) + e^- \rightarrow K(s)}$
options.D:
X：$\mathrm{Ag(s) \rightarrow Ag^+(aq) + e^-}$；Y：$\mathrm{2H^+(aq) + 2e^- \rightarrow H_2(g)}$
X: $\mathrm{Ag(s) \rightarrow Ag^+(aq) + e^-}$; Y: $\mathrm{2H^+(aq) + 2e^- \rightarrow H_2(g)}$

category: 氧化還原反應、化學電池和電解/Redox Reactions, Chemical Cells and Electrolysis
questionText:
下圖所示為以氫氧化鈉溶液作電解質的氫-氧燃料電池。下列哪項有關這電池運作的陳述正確？
The diagram below shows a hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell using sodium hydroxide solution as the electrolyte. Which of the following statements concerning the operation of this cell is correct?

options.A:
電極 Y 上的半反應式為 $\mathrm{O_2(g) + 4H^+(aq) + 4e^- \rightarrow 2H_2O(l)}$。
The half equation at electrode Y is $\mathrm{O_2(g) + 4H^+(aq) + 4e^- \rightarrow 2H_2O(l)}$.
options.B:
氫氧化鈉溶液的濃度逐漸上升。
The concentration of the sodium hydroxide solution gradually increases.
options.C:
電解質中的 $\mathrm{OH^-(aq)}$ 離子向電極 X 遷移。
$\mathrm{OH^-(aq)}$ ions in the electrolyte migrate towards electrode X.
options.D:
由於生成的水可被電解，這電池屬於二次電池。
The cell is a secondary cell because the water formed can be electrolysed.

category: 氧化還原反應、化學電池和電解/Redox Reactions, Chemical Cells and Electrolysis
questionText:
考慮以下反應：
$\mathrm{2KMnO_4(s) \rightarrow K_2MnO_4(s) + MnO_2(s) + O_2(g)}$
下列有關這反應的陳述，何者正確？
(1) 錳的氧化數由 +7 分別變為 +6 和 +4。
(2) $\mathrm{KMnO_4}$ 同時作為氧化劑和還原劑。
(3) 每生成 1 mol $\mathrm{O_2(g)}$，有 2 mol 電子轉移。
Consider the following reaction:
$\mathrm{2KMnO_4(s) \rightarrow K_2MnO_4(s) + MnO_2(s) + O_2(g)}$
Which of the following statements concerning this reaction is / are correct?
(1) The oxidation number of manganese changes from +7 to +6 and +4 respectively.
(2) $\mathrm{KMnO_4}$ acts as both an oxidising agent and a reducing agent.
(3) 2 mol of electrons are transferred for every 1 mol of $\mathrm{O_2(g)}$ formed.

category: 金屬/Metals
questionText:
考慮金屬 R、S 和 T 的氧化物的以下資料：
R 的氧化物：與碳一同強熱，得金屬 R
S 的氧化物：與碳一同強熱，沒有反應
T 的氧化物：單獨加熱，分解為金屬 T
下列有關 R、S 和 T 的陳述，何者正確？
(1) S 的活性較 R 高。
(2) 把 R 放入 T 的鹽溶液中，R 可置換出 T。
(3) T 的氧化物受熱分解，顯示 T 的活性較 R 高。
Consider the following information about the oxides of metals R, S and T:
Oxide of R: gives metal R when strongly heated with carbon
Oxide of S: no reaction when strongly heated with carbon
Oxide of T: decomposes to metal T on heating alone
Which of the following statements concerning R, S and T is / are correct?
(1) S is more reactive than R.
(2) R can displace T when R is placed in a solution of a salt of T.
(3) The decomposition of the oxide of T on heating shows that T is more reactive than R.

questionText:

questionText:
考慮下列各陳述句並選出最佳的答案：
第一陳述句：熔融的鋁能導電。
第二陳述句：熔融的鋁含有離域電子。
Consider the following statements and choose the best answer:
1st statement: Molten aluminium conducts electricity.
2nd statement: Molten aluminium contains delocalised electrons.

options.A:
兩陳述句均正確，而第二陳述句為第一陳述句的合理解釋。
Both statements are true and the 2nd statement is a correct explanation of the 1st statement.
options.B:
兩陳述句均正確，但第二陳述句並非第一陳述句的合理解釋。
Both statements are true but the 2nd statement is NOT a correct explanation of the 1st statement.
options.C:

The 1st statement is false but the 2nd statement is true.
options.D:
兩陳述句均錯誤。

category: 化學平衡/Chemical Equilibrium
questionText:
在一帶活塞的密閉容器中，以下體系於恆溫下達致平衡：
$\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$
此時 $\mathrm{NH_3(g)}$ 的濃度為 $c$。在時間 $t$，把活塞迅速推入，令容器體積減半，溫度保持不變，體系其後再次達致平衡。下列哪幅坐標圖正確顯示 $\mathrm{NH_3(g)}$ 的濃度隨時間的變化？
The following system attains equilibrium at constant temperature in a closed container fitted with a piston:
$\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$
The concentration of $\mathrm{NH_3(g)}$ is then $c$. At time $t$, the piston is quickly pushed in so that the volume of the container is halved, while the temperature is kept constant. The system then attains equilibrium again. Which of the following graphs correctly shows the variation in the concentration of $\mathrm{NH_3(g)}$ with time?

category: 化學平衡/Chemical Equilibrium
questionText:

At a certain temperature, the equilibrium constant $K_c$ of the reaction $\mathrm{H_2(g) + Br_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2HBr(g)}$ is 64.0. What is the equilibrium constant $K_c$ of the reaction $\mathrm{HBr(g) \rightleftharpoons \frac{1}{2}H_2(g) + \frac{1}{2}Br_2(g)}$ at the same temperature?

category: 化學平衡/Chemical Equilibrium
questionText:

達致平衡時，容器內有 0.20 mol $\mathrm{Cl_2(g)}$。這反應在該溫度下的 $K_c$ 是多少？

category: 反應速率/Rate of Reaction
questionText:
進行以下兩個實驗，以探究次氯酸鈉溶液在氧化鈷粉末催化下的分解：
$\mathrm{2NaOCl(aq) \rightarrow 2NaCl(aq) + O_2(g)}$
實驗 I：25 °C，$100\ \text{cm}^3$ $0.40\ \text{M}$ NaOCl(aq)，加入 0.50 g 氧化鈷
實驗 II：35 °C，$50\ \text{cm}^3$ $0.40\ \text{M}$ NaOCl(aq)，加入 0.50 g 氧化鈷
氣體體積都在室內條件下量度。下列有關這兩個實驗的陳述，何者正確？
(1) 與實驗 I 相比，實驗 II 的初速較高。
(2) 實驗 II 最終釋出的氧氣體積是實驗 I 的一半。
(3) 反應完結後，兩個實驗中氧化鈷的質量都減少了。
The following two experiments are carried out to investigate the decomposition of sodium hypochlorite solution catalysed by cobalt oxide powder:
$\mathrm{2NaOCl(aq) \rightarrow 2NaCl(aq) + O_2(g)}$
Experiment I: 25 °C, $100\ \text{cm}^3$ of $0.40\ \text{M}$ NaOCl(aq) with 0.50 g of cobalt oxide
Experiment II: 35 °C, $50\ \text{cm}^3$ of $0.40\ \text{M}$ NaOCl(aq) with 0.50 g of cobalt oxide
Gas volumes are all measured at room conditions. Which of the following statements concerning these two experiments is / are correct?
(1) In comparison with Experiment I, the initial rate in Experiment II is higher.
(2) The final volume of oxygen evolved in Experiment II is half of that in Experiment I.
(3) After the reaction, the mass of cobalt oxide has decreased in both experiments.

category: 碳化合物的化學/Chemistry of Carbon Compounds
questionText:
考慮下列各陳述句並選出最佳的答案：
第一陳述句：$\mathrm{(CH_3)_2CHCH(OH)CH(CH_3)_2}$ 有一雙對映異構體。
第二陳述句：$\mathrm{(CH_3)_2CHCH(OH)CH(CH_3)_2}$ 是二級醇。
Consider the following statements and choose the best answer:
1st statement: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_2CHCH(OH)CH(CH_3)_2}$ has a pair of enantiomers.
2nd statement: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_2CHCH(OH)CH(CH_3)_2}$ is a secondary alcohol.

options.A:
兩陳述句均正確，而第二陳述句為第一陳述句的合理解釋。
Both statements are true and the 2nd statement is a correct explanation of the 1st statement.
options.B:
兩陳述句均正確，但第二陳述句並非第一陳述句的合理解釋。
Both statements are true but the 2nd statement is NOT a correct explanation of the 1st statement.
options.C:
第一陳述句錯誤，但第二陳述句正確。
The 1st statement is false but the 2nd statement is true.
options.D:
兩陳述句均錯誤。
Both statements are false.
